digest.component_or_area: bridge runner entrypoint and repair-pause ownership
propositions: Bridge execution must work uniformly across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single runner-neutral entrypoint and thin provider-specific wrappers.
Legacy reconcile vocabulary and all current MODE routes must be preserved with unchanged exit behavior, defaults, and mutation boundaries for checked-out workflows.
Destructive-repair pause ownership must become provider-neutral and remove dependency on GitHub CLI for schedule safety, using per-invocation repair tokens and foreign-pause abort semantics.
Runner must parse and strictly enforce BRIDGE_PAUSED tickets with commit/push verification while canonicalizing legacy exit codes only at wrapper boundaries.
Legacy reconcile callers must retain published defaults, exit codes, and direct output without modification when using existing invocation paths.
Each child task (runner-neutral bridge and provider-neutral destructive-repair) must be independently releasable with non-overlapping file impacts and hold RED-first TDD.
